what_this_is: The forecast harness, fixed before the first forecast row exists. The git log of this file is the proof: 'promoted' is filled from development scores only, in its own commit, before any locked-period row is written, and the locked test runs once.
target: M-01, eligible reports per product code per receipt month

warmup.purpose: errors that calibrate the first development ranges

development.purpose: model selection; promotion is decided here and nowhere else

outlook.purpose: the next-month figure; 2026-09 issued in 2026-10 is an elapsed-period estimate

baseline_a.form: trailing three-month mean of the series at the origin, same point at every horizon

baseline_b.form: the series value twelve months before the target

candidate.form: ETS with additive error, damped additive trend and additive seasonality of period 12, fitted by maximum likelihood on log1p(count) over the history through the origin, back-transformed with expm1 and floored at zero
candidate.library: statsmodels 0.15.0 ETSModel(error='add', trend='add', damped_trend=true, seasonal='add', seasonal_periods=12)
candidate.exported_per_origin: smoothing_level, smoothing_trend, smoothing_seasonal, damping_trend, final level, final trend, the last twelve seasonal states oldest first; the independent path recomputes every point from these

intervals.method: empirical quantiles of the signed errors (actual minus point) of the same model and horizon over the 36 most recent targets elapsed at the origin
intervals.fewer_than_min: no range is drawn and the row says so

promotion_rule.criterion: the candidate is promoted for a code when its MAE is at most 0.90 times the better baseline's MAE and its WIS is at most the better baseline's WIS; otherwise the better baseline is the model in use
promotion_rule.ties: the baseline with the lower MAE; baseline_a if equal

review_rule.model: the model in use for the code
review_rule.flag: actual above the 80% upper range and at least five reports above the point
review_rule.episode: a run of at least two consecutive flagged target months; one run is one episode; a flagged final month with no successor is pending
review_rule.disabled_when: 80% coverage of the model in use in the locked test, horizon 1, is below 0.70 (numbers gate G5)
